recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the work group wants to reserve additional local operation-parameter prefixes beyond the current x- note, handle that as a new policy decision rather than as a FHIR-3856 reconciliation fix.
issue_request: FHIR-3856 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 FHIR-I change request asking for preferred methods to extend operations for local implementation use and to reduce collision risk with future HL7 operation parameters.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN r4064, represented in git by 918490af7f19e4d0c1bdacbc7a74df5e7850c531, which added the note that FHIR will not define operation parameter names starting with x-. The surrounding operations page guidance already described defining new named parameters and publishing an extended OperationDefinition with OperationDefinition.base.
additional_context: The current operations page is active in source/hierarchy.xml, and OperationDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Later applied/published issues in the same area, especially FHIR-30509 and FHIR-38034, added the current detailed Derived OperationDefinitions guidance that derived operations can introduce new parameters while respecting the base operation. FHIR-28222 separately addressed operation code naming/collision guidance. Those related issues already have issue-reconcile commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already satisfies the seed issue when read with the later OperationDefinition guidance, and adding duplicative local prose would not materially improve implementer understanding.
